propositions: A gate run does not warn when its running build is behind the base ref it pins, causing it to silently execute with stale code and outdated configuration knowledge
The drift check must be implemented at the seam of `resolve_gate_handle` where the base ref is pinned to a sha and the snapshot is acquired

When drift is detected the gate must emit a single non-fatal warning per (build sha, pinned sha) pair naming the build sha, commit date, pinned sha, and commit count difference, without altering verdict or exit code
Unknown config keys must display different wording when the running build is known to be behind the pinned ref, clarifying the build may predate the key rather than suggesting a typo
The drift check must remain silent when provenance is unavailable, the build sha is absent from the target repo (different repositories), or the build is at or ahead of the pinned sha
